title: Senior Information Technology Recruiter
description:
Grey Parrot Systems (GPARROT) is hiring an experienced
**Senior IT Recruiter**
based in Khammam, India to own end-to-end IT recruitment for our US client engagements — sourcing, screening, and placing top technology talent across a wide range of IT roles.

**About Grey Parrot Systems**

Grey Parrot Systems (GPARROT) is a women-owned, BEP-certified IT services firm headquartered in Naperville, IL. We partner with mid-market enterprises to deliver AI-first, governance-driven digital transformation. Our team of seasoned CIO/CTO practitioners works side-by-side with clients across retail, logistics, manufacturing, and healthcare — and we're growing fast.

**About the Role**

This is a senior recruitment role for an experienced IT recruiter who knows how to source, engage, and place top technology talent for the US market — working US-aligned hours from our Khammam, India office. You will own the full recruitment lifecycle — from job intake and candidate sourcing through screening, submission, interview coordination, and offer management — across a wide range of IT roles including software engineers, architects, data engineers, QA engineers, DevOps, SAP consultants, and more. If you are a driven, target-oriented IT recruiter with strong US staffing experience and deep sourcing skills — this role is for you.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 4+ years of IT recruitment experience — US staffing strongly preferred
* Strong full-lifecycle recruitment experience — job intake, sourcing, screening, submission, interview coordination, and offer management
* Deep sourcing expertise — LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, Boolean search, social sourcing, and referral networks
* Experience recruiting across a broad range of IT roles — software engineers, architects, data engineers, QA engineers, DevOps, cloud specialists, SAP consultants, and more
* Strong understanding of US IT staffing models — W2, C2C, 1099, and contract-to-hire
* Experience working with ATS platforms — Bullhorn, JobDiva, Ceipal, or similar
* Excellent written and oral English communication skills — comfortable engaging directly with US-based candidates and hiring managers
* Comfortable working US-aligned business hours — EST / CST overlap required
* Strong target orientation — ability to manage high requisition volumes and meet weekly submission and placement targets
* Self-starter with a strong sense of urgency and ownership

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end IT recruitment across assigned requisitions — from job intake through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff
* Source top IT talent across multiple channels — LinkedIn Recruiter, Dice, Indeed, Monster, GitHub, and direct outreach campaigns
* Screen candidates — technical skill validation, communication assessment, availability, compensation, and work authorization verification
* Submit qualified candidates to hiring managers and account managers with well-crafted candidate profiles and summaries
* Coordinate and manage interview schedules — coordinating between candidates, hiring managers, and client stakeholders across US time zones
* Negotiate compensation and manage offer processes — W2, C2C, and contract-to-hire arrangements
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline across key IT skill sets — proactively engaging passive candidates for current and future requirements
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate and requisition records in the ATS
* Collaborate closely with account managers, business development teams, and client stakeholders to understand job requirements and delivery priorities
* Use AI-powered sourcing and outreach tools to accelerate candidate discovery and engagement
* Track and report on recruitment metrics — submissions, interviews, offers, placements, and time-to-fill
* Continuously improve sourcing strategies, candidate engagement, and recruitment processes

**Tools You'll Use**

LinkedIn Recruiter · Dice · Indeed · Monster · Boolean Search · ATS (Bullhorn / JobDiva / Ceipal) · AI Sourcing Tools · Microsoft 365 · Zoom / Teams

**Target IT Skill Areas**

Software Engineering (.NET, Java, Python, Node.js) · Full Stack Development · Cloud & DevOps (AWS / Azure / GCP) · Data Engineering & Analytics · QA & Test Automation · SAP Consultants · Salesforce · AI / ML Engineers · Cybersecurity · Project Management & Business Analysis

**Nice to Have**

* Experience recruiting for US staffing firms or IT consulting companies
* Familiarity with VMS platforms — Beeline, Fieldglass, or similar
* Experience with AI-powered recruiting tools — HireEZ, SeekOut, or similar
* Strong understanding of US work authorization categories — H1B, GC, USC, OPT, TN
* Experience recruiting niche or hard-to-fill IT skill sets — SAP, Salesforce, legacy systems, or emerging AI roles

**Details**

* Location: Khammam, India — On-Site
* Experience: 4+ years of IT recruitment experience
* Type: Full-Time
* Working Hours: US-aligned (EST / CST overlap required)
* Start: Immediate

Grey Parrot Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As a women-owned, BEP and WBENC-certified firm, diversity and inclusion are core to who we are. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

**Stay Connected**

For more job openings, company updates, and AI industry insights, follow Grey Parrot Systems on LinkedIn.

👉 https://www.linkedin.com/company/gparrot/

We are always looking for talented, driven professionals to join our growing team. Whether this role is the right fit today or not, connect with us and be the first to hear about new opportunities as we expand across Chicago, Detroit, and the Midwest.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist II
description:
**Description**
Talent Acquisition Specialist II
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**

* In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.
* Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.
* As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.
* Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction. Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.
* Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.
* Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.
* Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.
* Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.
* May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.
* May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.
* Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

**What we’re looking for:**
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment
* Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end-to-end recruiting process required.
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality

**Preferred Experienc**
e:
  
  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com
  
  
**Additional Information**
Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
